newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Benxi Steel plans 400 mln B share offer.
newsitem.headline: China's Benxi Steel plans 400 mln B share offer.

text.p: Benxi Iron and Steel Co in northeastern China'a Liaoning province expects to issue 400 million B shares this year, a company official said on Thursday.
"We are trying to launch the offer this year," the official said by telephone from the company's headquarters in Benxi city.
Pricing has not yet been set and there has been no decision on whether the shares will be listed on the Shanghai or the Shenzhen stock exchanges, he said.
Benxi Iron and Steel is among the 33 domestic companies approved to issue foreign currency denominated B shares by the Securities Commission of the State Council.
Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co has been named as the main domestic underwriter, and a unidentified foreign firm has been chosen as the international coordinator, he said.
The company also plans to issue and list A shares in 1997, the official said without elaborating.
Funds raised would be used for technical upgrading for a hot-rolling plant and another steel casting project, he said.
Domestic demand for steel products had been restrained by government efforts to slow the pace of basic construction in recent years, he said. He did not forecast this year's demand.
